blurb: Discover the sweeter side of paradise on the Key West Sweets Tour! This fun and flavorful walking tour takes you through the heart of Old Town, along the harborfront and seaport, with stops at some of the best local spots for delicious donuts and sweet treats. Along the way, you’ll learn all about Key West’s rich and colorful history, from pirates and pioneers to artists and eccentrics. With plenty of photo-worthy moments, historic sites, and tasty bites, it’s the perfect outing for families, friends, and anyone looking to explore Key West in a unique and memorable way. Come hungry, bring your camera, and get ready to enjoy a one-of-a-kind tour through this tropical island treasure!
